## Change type

- [ ] `feat`: new behavior
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: tests or fixtures
- [ ] `chore` / `refactor`: maintenance without intended behavior change
- [ ] `security`: security improvement

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
- [ ] CI passes on Node.js 20, 22, and 24.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures use reserved domains and contain no real scan data.

## Security and privacy review

- [ ] No credentials, private hostnames, IP addresses, or sensitive scan results are included.
- [ ] Network behavior remains bounded and non-intrusive, or any change is explained above.
- [ ] Input validation and error handling were considered.
